title: roadmap-map-guard: ROADMAP.md live block went stale on every research-queue PR (volatile counts column)

Fix: counts removed from the committed block (live in --report); block now stale only when milestones.yaml content changes; self-test proves both. Closes when: guards stay green on main across the next >=2 research-queue PRs.
